The '''Chiewab Medical Droid''' was a model of [[medical droid]] manufactured by [[Chiewab Amalgamated Pharmaceuticals Company]]<ref name="Episode Guide" /> that shared parts with a [[Unidentified science droid model/Legends|science droid model]].<ref name="Eminence" /><ref name="The Zillo Beast Strikes Back">{{TCW|The Zillo Beast Strikes Back}}</ref>
